why: THE HAND-SIZE PUNISHER PACKAGE IS THE WORST THING IN THE DECK; convert card flow into a board instead. Measured on the 20-game pod run: our seat's noncombat damage to players was mean 1.75 with a MEDIAN OF 0 over ~34-turn games, and we were eliminated by creature decks 13 times in 20. Iron Maiden and Viseling read hand-size-minus-four and Ebony Owl Netsuke wants seven, so all three are dead against anyone who spends their hand. Out: those three plus Tireless Tribe, Wall of Glare and Darien. In: Leyline of Anticipation (the flash redundancy the paper list cut - the deck has THREE cards with Flash printed and the whole end-step plan rides on a commander that resolved in 30% of games), Archmage Emeritus and Murmuring Mystic (28 instants and sorceries in the 99, and the Mystic is a 1/5 that answers the creature decks in the same slot), Chasm Skulker and Teferi Temporal Pilgrim (payoffs for our OWN draws), and Krang the All-Powerful, which makes every draw-triggered permanent we control trigger twice - Psychosis Crawler, Scrawling Crawler, Consecrated Sphinx, Faerie Mastermind, Smothering Tithe. THE GOLDFISH CANNOT GRADE THE HYPOTHESIS: classify() returns draw={unmodelled} for Archmage Emeritus, Chasm Skulker and Teferi, and reads Krang as a bare 3-power body, so four of the six adds have their text unread. board_power_6 is pre-registered because it is the one component the model CAN see; the verdict is the Forge experiment against v1.0.1, where all six are trigger-based and none carries an AI:RemoveDeck flag.
